_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or set the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable to another path). This file holds only the database and skill_dir entries. Other settings such as the LLM are set through environment variables or in the app, not in this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > the database entry in this file. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill in the individual fields below, or (B) fill in only database.dsn with a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): remove the database block above and use a complete DSN instead. When dsn is not empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory of skills (each subdirectory is one skill and contains SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
